description: Source code for test utilities related to trace2 event testing in a Git-like environment, including functions to simulate process exit, error reporting, child process execution, and trace2 event emission.

methods.name: get_i
methods.description: Parses an integer from a string, returning MyOk or MyError.

methods.name: ut_001return
methods.description: Simulates process exit with a specified code, testing trace2 exit event.

methods.name: ut_002exit
methods.description: Exits process with a specified code, testing trace2 exit event.

methods.name: ut_003error
methods.description: Sends multiple error events with provided messages.

methods.name: ut_004child
methods.description: Runs a child process and exits with its return code, testing child process trace events.

methods.name: ut_005exec
methods.description: Executes a git command, testing process replacement trace events.

methods.name: ut_006data
methods.description: Sends trace2 data string events with categories and key-value pairs.

methods.name: ut_007BUG
methods.description: Exercises BUG() macro to ensure trace2 bug message logging.

methods.name: ut_008bug
methods.description: Logs bug messages and BUG_if_bug for trace2 testing.

methods.name: ut_009bug_BUG
methods.description: Logs bug messages without BUG_if_bug, testing trace2 bug reporting.

methods.name: ut_010bug_BUG
methods.description: Logs bug with formatted message, testing trace2 bug reporting.

methods.name: ut_100timer
methods.description: Tests single timer start/stop events.

methods.name: ut_101timer_thread_proc
methods.description: Thread procedure to create timer events.

methods.name: ut_101timer
methods.description: Tests multi-threaded timer events.

methods.name: ut_200counter
methods.description: Adds multiple values to a counter for trace2 testing.

methods.name: ut_201counter_thread_proc
methods.description: Thread procedure to add counter values.

methods.name: ut_201counter
methods.description: Tests multi-threaded counter events.

methods.name: ut_300redact_start
methods.description: Tests trace2 command start event.

methods.name: ut_301redact_child_start
methods.description: Tests trace2 child process start event.

methods.name: ut_302redact_exec
methods.description: Tests trace2 exec event.

methods.name: ut_303redact_def_param
methods.description: Tests trace2 define parameter event.
